WITH CTL AS (
    SELECT CAST('2025-10-30' AS DATE) CRM_DATE
),

EMAIL AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            ORGKEY,
            BANK_ID,
            EMAIL,
            LAST_UPDATED_DATE,
            SCD_Start_Date,
            SCD_End_Date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ORGKEY ORDER BY TMDATE DESC) AS RN
        FROM EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL
        WHERE PHONEOREMAIL = 'EMAIL'
          AND PHONEEMAILTYPE = 'OACEML'
          AND ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL
		  AND ISLATEST=1
    ) X
    WHERE RN = 1
),

PHONE AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            ORGKEY,
            BANK_ID,
            PHONENO,
            LAST_UPDATED_DATE,
            SCD_Start_Date,
            SCD_End_Date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ORGKEY ORDER BY TMDATE DESC) AS RN
        FROM EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL
        WHERE PHONEOREMAIL = 'PHONE'
          AND PHONEEMAILTYPE = 'OTPPH'
          AND ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL
	      AND ISLATEST=1
    ) X
    WHERE RN = 1
),

CURRADDRESS AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            CORE_CUST_ID,
            ORGKEY,
            BANK_ID,
            ADDRESS_LINE1,
            ADDRESS_LINE2,
            CITY,
            [STATE],
            COUNTRY,
            ZIP,
            SCD_Start_Date,
            SCD_End_Date,
            LASTUPDATE_DATE,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ORGKEY ORDER BY ADDRESSID DESC) AS RN
        FROM EDS.CRM_ADDRESS
        WHERE ADDRESSCATEGORY = 'Present'
          AND END_DATE = '2099-12-31'
    ) X
    WHERE RN = 1
),

PERMADDRESS AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            CORE_CUST_ID,
            ORGKEY,
            BANK_ID,
            ADDRESS_LINE1,
            ADDRESS_LINE2,
            CITY,
            [STATE],
            COUNTRY,
            ZIP,
            SCD_Start_Date,
            SCD_End_Date,
            LASTUPDATE_DATE,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ORGKEY ORDER BY ADDRESSID DESC) AS RN
        FROM EDS.CRM_ADDRESS
        WHERE ADDRESSCATEGORY = 'Home'
          --AND  PREFERREDADDRESS = 'Y'
          AND END_DATE = '2099-12-31'
    ) X
    WHERE RN = 1
),

OCCUPATION AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            CORE_CUST_ID,
            ORGKEY,
            BANK_ID,
            STRTEXT2,
            STRTEXT3,
            STRTEXT4,
            SCD_Start_Date,
            SCD_End_Date,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ORGKEY ORDER BY MISCELLANEOUSID DESC) AS RN
        FROM EDS.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO
        WHERE TYPE = 'CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT'
		AND ISLATEST=1
    ) X
    WHERE RN = 1
),

RISKRATING AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ORGKEY ORDER BY MISCELLANEOUSID DESC) AS RN, * 
        FROM EDS.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO 
        WHERE TYPE = 'Risk_Type'
		AND ISLATEST=1
    ) X 
    WHERE RN = 1
),

AMLKYC AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ORGKEY ORDER BY AML_KYC_ID DESC) AS RN, * 
        FROM EDS.CRM_AMLKYC
		WHERE ISLATEST=1
    ) X 
    WHERE RN = 1
), 


MAIN AS (
SELECT
    CTL.CRM_DATE AS AS_OF_DATE,
    CUST.NAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME,
    CUST.ORGKEY AS CIF_ID,
    NULL AS REF_CODE,
    SEG.L1_SEGMENT_DESC AS [L1_SEGMENT],
    SEG.L2_SEGMENT_DESC AS [L2_SEGMENT],
    SEG.L1_SEGMENT_ID AS [L1_SEGMENT_ID],
    NULL AS VULNERABILTY_TYPE,
    NULL AS VIP_TAG,
    CUST.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS RELATIONSHIPSTARTDATE,
    EMAIL.EMAIL,
    EMAIL.LAST_UPDATED_DATE AS EMAIL_LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
    PHONE.PHONENO AS MOBILE,
    PHONE.LAST_UPDATED_DATE AS MOBILE_LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
    CONCAT(
        CA.ADDRESS_LINE1, ' ', CA.ADDRESS_LINE2, ', ',
        CITY.DESCRIPTION, ', ',
        STATE.DESCRIPTION, ', ',
        CA.ZIP, ', ',
        COUNTRY.DESCRIPTION
    ) AS CURRENT_ADDRESS,
    CA.LASTUPDATE_DATE AS CURRENT_ADDRESS_LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
    CONCAT(
        PA.ADDRESS_LINE1, ' ', PA.ADDRESS_LINE2, ', ',
        CITY.DESCRIPTION, ', ',
        STATE.DESCRIPTION, ', ',
        PA.ZIP, ', ',
        COUNTRY.DESCRIPTION
    ) AS PERMANENT_ADDRESS,
    PA.LASTUPDATE_DATE AS PERMANENT_ADDRESS_LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
    CAST(DATEDIFF(DAY, CUST.CUST_DOB, CTL.CRM_DATE) / 365.25 AS INT) AS AGE,
    MS.DESCRIPTION AS MARITAL_STATUS,
    CUST.STRUSERFIELD5 AS SOURCE_OF_FUNDS,
    CUST.CUST_DOB AS DATE_OF_BIRTH,
    UPPER(GENDER.DESCRIPTION) AS GENDER,
    OCC.DESCRIPTION AS OCCUPATION,
    O.STRTEXT4 AS EMPLOYER_NAME,
    MV_INDUSTRY_TYPE.DESCRIPTION AS INDUSTRY_TYPE,
    AML.CUSTOMER_SUBTYPE AS CUSTOMER_SUBTYPE,
    MV_CBC_RATING_TYPE.DESCRIPTION AS [RISK_RATING_TYPE],
    RISK.STRTEXT21 AS [RISK_RATING_NAME],
    TRB.TRB AS [TOTAL_REL_BALANCE],
    TRB.CUST_SEGMENT_ID,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TRB.TRB DESC) AS CUST_RANK
FROM eds.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
INNER JOIN CTL
    ON CUST.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
	AND CUST.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
	AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN CUST.SCD_START_DATE AND CUST.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN eds.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT SEG
    ON CUST.ORGKEY = SEG.CIF
	AND CUST.BANK_ID = SEG.BANK_ID
	AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN SEG.SCD_Start_Date AND SEG.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_TOTAL_REL TRB 
    ON CUST.ORGKEY = TRB.CIF 
    AND CUST.BANK_ID = TRB.BANK_ID
	AND TRB.AS_OF_DATE <= CTL.CRM_DATE
LEFT JOIN EMAIL
    ON CUST.ORGKEY = EMAIL.ORGKEY
   AND CUST.BANK_ID = EMAIL.BANK_ID
   AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN EMAIL.SCD_Start_Date AND EMAIL.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN PHONE
    ON CUST.ORGKEY = PHONE.ORGKEY
   AND CUST.BANK_ID = PHONE.BANK_ID
   AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN PHONE.SCD_Start_Date AND PHONE.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN CURRADDRESS CA
    ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = CA.CORE_CUST_ID
   AND CUST.ORGKEY = CA.ORGKEY
   AND CUST.BANK_ID = CA.BANK_ID
   AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN CA.SCD_Start_Date AND CA.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN PERMADDRESS PA
    ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = PA.CORE_CUST_ID
   AND CUST.ORGKEY = PA.ORGKEY
   AND CUST.BANK_ID = PA.BANK_ID
   AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN PA.SCD_Start_Date AND PA.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC DEM
    ON CUST.ORGKEY = DEM.ORGKEY
   AND CUST.BANK_ID = DEM.BANK_ID
   AND DEM.MARITAL_STATUS <> ''
   AND DEM.ACCOUNTID IS NOT NULL
   AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN DEM.SCD_Start_Date AND DEM.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_MARITAL_STATUS_DIM MS
    ON MS.[VALUE] = DEM.MARITAL_STATUS
   AND MS.BANK_ID = DEM.BANK_ID
   AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN MS.SCD_Start_Date AND MS.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_GENDER_DIM GENDER
    ON GENDER.[VALUE] = CUST.GENDER
   AND GENDER.BANK_ID = CUST.BANK_ID
   AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN GENDER.SCD_Start_Date AND GENDER.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN OCCUPATION O
    ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = O.CORE_CUST_ID
   AND CUST.ORGKEY = O.ORGKEY
   AND CUST.BANK_ID = O.BANK_ID
   AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN O.SCD_Start_Date AND O.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_CONTACT_OCCUPATION_DIM OCC
    ON OCC.[VALUE] = O.STRTEXT2
   AND OCC.BANK_ID = O.BANK_ID
   AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN OCC.SCD_Start_Date AND OCC.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_CITY_DIM CITY
    ON CITY.[VALUE] = CA.CITY
   AND CITY.BANK_ID = CA.BANK_ID
   AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN CITY.SCD_Start_Date AND CITY.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_STATE_DIM STATE
    ON STATE.[VALUE] = CA.[STATE]
   AND STATE.BANK_ID = CA.BANK_ID
   AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN STATE.SCD_Start_Date AND STATE.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_COUNTRY_DIM COUNTRY
    ON COUNTRY.[VALUE] = CA.COUNTRY
   AND COUNTRY.BANK_ID = CA.BANK_ID
   AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN COUNTRY.SCD_Start_Date AND COUNTRY.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN RISKRATING RISK
    ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = RISK.CORE_CUST_ID AND CUST.ORGKEY = RISK.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = RISK.BANK_ID
    AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN RISK.SCD_Start_Date AND RISK.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN AMLKYC AML
    ON CUST.CORE_CUST_ID = AML.CORE_CUST_ID AND CUST.ORGKEY = AML.ORGKEY AND CUST.BANK_ID = AML.BANK_ID
    AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN AML.SCD_Start_Date AND AML.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_CBC_RATING_TYPE_DIM AS MV_CBC_RATING_TYPE
	ON MV_CBC_RATING_TYPE.[VALUE] = RISK.STRTEXT20
	AND MV_CBC_RATING_TYPE.BANK_ID = RISK.BANK_ID
	AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN MV_CBC_RATING_TYPE.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_CBC_RATING_TYPE.SCD_End_Date
LEFT JOIN EDS.MV_INDUSTRY_TYPE_DIM AS MV_INDUSTRY_TYPE
	ON O.STRTEXT3 = MV_INDUSTRY_TYPE.VALUE
	AND O.BANK_ID = MV_INDUSTRY_TYPE.BANK_ID
	AND CTL.CRM_DATE BETWEEN MV_INDUSTRY_TYPE.SCD_Start_Date AND MV_INDUSTRY_TYPE.SCD_End_Date
)

SELECT
    AS_OF_DATE,
    CUSTOMER_NAME,
    CIF_ID,
    REF_CODE,
    L1_SEGMENT,
    L2_SEGMENT,
    L1_SEGMENT_ID,
    VULNERABILTY_TYPE,
    VIP_TAG,
    RELATIONSHIPSTARTDATE,
    EMAIL,
    EMAIL_LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
    MOBILE,
    MOBILE_LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
    CURRENT_ADDRESS,
    CURRENT_ADDRESS_LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
    PERMANENT_ADDRESS,
    PERMANENT_ADDRESS_LAST_UPDATE_DATE,
    AGE,
    MARITAL_STATUS,
    SOURCE_OF_FUNDS,
    DATE_OF_BIRTH,
    GENDER,
    OCCUPATION,
    EMPLOYER_NAME,
    INDUSTRY_TYPE,
    CUSTOMER_SUBTYPE,
    RISK_RATING_TYPE,
    RISK_RATING_NAME
    --CIF_ID,count(*) as counted
FROM MAIN 
WHERE CUST_RANK <= 1500000
AND CIF_ID='R00155637'
--GROUP BY CIF_ID 
--ORDER BY counted DESC
